text_block_list.text: You see, Marvelous is a wonderful surprise☆ And I'm the Umamusume who shows you what's Marvelous★

text_block_list.text:

After all, today is the long-awaited first—"
choice_data_list: Marvelous, get back to the paddock!

text_block_list.text:
"The day of the Make Debut has finally arrived.
Marvelous Sunday is in the absolute best of spirits."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The moment you take your eyes off her, she goes around making Marvelous appeals to anyone and everyone, keeping me on edge all morning.

text_block_list.text:
Nice to meet you☆ How are you doing★

text_block_list.text:
Because today is the start of the
'World Marvelous Project'☆★

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.text: Wh-What an intense girl...! Could she be the one making all that racket over there earlier...?

text_block_list.text:
I had no idea what she was talking about...
What was it again, World Marvelous...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because it's a completely new concept to them,
the spectators look utterly bewildered by the repeated chants of "Marvelous!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, it can't be helped.
They simply don't know the potential of "Marvelous" yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, as "Marvelous" spreads,
we'll surely hear shouts of "Marvelous" from all over the place—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, Trainer!
I'm so excited☆ I'm itching to go★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how far it'll reach?
Will I be able to make it reach them?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The world is full of Marvelous☆
If you find the Marvelous,
everyone can be happy★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:

The potential for happiness that every single person holds!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That's why—
choice_data_list: Go give it your all in your Make Debut!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Watch closely, Trainer!
Today, I'll pay you back with a wonderful, marvelous time too☆
